fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline / Meta Description
fields.description: Short description used in browser tabs and search results

fields.name: address
fields.label: Address
fields.description: Must match the Google, Apple and Facebook listings exactly

fields.name: state
fields.label: State
fields.description: Two letters — e.g. OH

fields.name: latitude
fields.label: Latitude
fields.description: Optional. Helps Google place the pin exactly — read it off Google Maps.

fields.name: longitude
fields.label: Longitude
fields.description: Optional.

fields.name: servesCuisine
fields.label: Cuisine
fields.description: What Google lists the cafe as serving, e.g. 'American'

fields.name: priceRange
fields.label: Price Range
fields.description: Google's shorthand for how expensive the place is

fields.name: acceptsReservations
fields.label: Takes Reservations?
fields.description: Left as 'not stated' until you confirm it — Google would rather be told nothing than told wrong

fields.name: ordering
fields.label: Order Online
fields.description: Delivery and pickup links. Leave all three empty and no Order button appears anywhere on the site.

fields.name: reviewsSummary
fields.label: Review Score
fields.description: The star rating shown on the home page. Leave the rating or the count empty and nothing is shown at all — better than showing half of it.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Link to the reviews
fields.description: Where 'see more' goes. Ideally your one-click review link.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Opening Hours
fields.description: One row per day. These feed both the hours shown on the site and the structured data Google reads — there is nowhere else to change them.

fields.name: footerText
fields.label: Footer Text
fields.description: e.g. © The Front Street Cafe 2026

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: Title for Google / browser tab
fields.description: Shown in search results and the browser tab, with the cafe name added after it. Keep it under about 40 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Search Description
fields.description: The sentence Google shows under the title. Aim for 150 characters, and avoid hours or prices here — they go stale.

fields.description: Optional blurb shown under the section heading

fields.name: order
fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Low numbers first. Leave gaps (10, 20, 30) so sections are easy to move.

fields.name: published
fields.label: Show on Site
fields.description: Turn off to hide the whole section and everything in it

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.description: Typed exactly as it should appear — '$16.99', '$3', 'Market price'. For two sizes, put the smaller one here and use the Second Price fields below.

fields.name: priceNote
fields.label: Price Label (optional)
fields.description: Only for two-size items — e.g. 'Half', 'Cup', 'Single'

fields.name: altPrice
fields.label: Second Price (optional)
fields.description: e.g. '$12.99' for the full-size portion

fields.name: altPriceNote
fields.label: Second Price Label (optional)
fields.description: e.g. 'Full', 'Bowl', 'Double'

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Low numbers first, within the section. Leave gaps (10, 20, 30).

fields.name: available

fields.description: Turn off when an item is off the menu — no need to delete it

fields.name: author
fields.label: Guest's Name
fields.description: As they signed the review — 'Sarah M.' is fine

fields.name: quote
fields.label: What they said
fields.description: Type it out rather than pasting a screenshot, and don't edit their words

fields.name: rating
fields.label: Stars they gave (optional)
fields.description: 1 to 5

fields.name: published
fields.label: Show on Site
fields.description: Reviews pulled in from Google start off. Turn one on to put it on the site.

fields.name: googleReviewId
fields.label: Google review ID
fields.description: Set by the sync so it can recognise this review again. Don't edit.

fields.name: reviewedAt
fields.label: Date of the review
fields.description: Set by the sync.

fields.name: syncNote
fields.label: Note from the sync
fields.description: The sync leaves messages here, e.g. if a review disappears from Google.
